## Summary by CodeRabbit

## Release Notes – v0.18.0

* **New Features**
  * MultiKueue extended test coverage and improvements across multiple worker clusters.
  * Enhanced topology-aware scheduling with improved logger integration.
  * Better DRA error handling to distinguish transient cluster-state issues from validation errors.

* **Bug Fixes**
  * Improved webhook endpoint readiness checks during cluster operations.
  * Fixed event message truncation for clearer Kubernetes event logging.

* **Documentation**
  * Updated Helm chart and installation instructions to v0.18.0.
  * Expanded e2e test configuration examples.

* **Chores**
  * Dependency version updates; enhanced build retry mechanisms.

## Walkthrough
This PR updates release metadata, chart/versioned docs, shared build/test tooling, DRA and scheduler behavior, and multiple e2e/integration test flows.

## Changes
**Release and tooling**

|Layer / File(s)|Summary|
|---|---|
|**Release metadata and docs** <br> `CHANGELOG/CHANGELOG-0.18.md`, `Makefile`, `README.md`, `charts/kueue/*`, `cmd/kueueviz/INSTALL.md`, `site/hugo.toml`|`v0.18.0` version values, install examples, chart defaults, and site metadata are updated across release docs and chart files.|
|**Build and dependency manifests** <br> `Makefile*`, `cloudbuild.yaml`, `go.mod`, `hack/tools/*`, `vendor/*`, `.github/dependabot.yml`, `.gitignore`|Build targets, retry plumbing, tool dependencies, vendored driver files, and ignore rules are updated.|
  
**Experimental charts and RBAC**

|Layer / File(s)|Summary|
|---|---|
|**Populator chart and RBAC** <br> `cmd/experimental/kueue-populator/*`|The populator chart metadata, image tag, RBAC, and install docs are updated.|
|**Priority booster chart generation** <br> `cmd/experimental/kueue-priority-booster/*`|The priority-booster Helm generation flow, chart templates, values, and RBAC are updated, and `verify` now includes Helm rendering.|

**Core runtime, scheduler, and workload behavior**

|Layer / File(s)|Summary|
|---|---|
|**Metrics and shared constants** <br> `pkg/cache/...`, `pkg/constants/...`, `pkg/metrics/*`, `pkg/controller/admissionchecks/provisioning/controller_test.go`|Borrowing-limit reporting, metric text, and the elastic-job annotation constant are updated.|
|**Event message truncation** <br> `pkg/controller/*`, `pkg/workload/workload.go`, `pkg/controller/admissionchecks/multikueue/workload.go`|Several event emitters now truncate recorded messages before writing them.|
|**DRA validation and retry classification** <br> `pkg/dra/*`, `pkg/controller/core/workload_controller.go`, `pkg/controller/core/workload_controller_test.go`|DRA validation errors now distinguish retryable internal errors from validation errors, and workload reconciliation tests cover the new backoff paths.|
|**Scheduler TAS flow** <br> `pkg/scheduler/*`, `pkg/scheduler/flavorassigner/*`, `pkg/controller/core/workload_controller.go`|Scheduler and flavor assignment code now pass logger/context through TAS usage computation and derive TAS usage from workload pod specs.|
|**Workload and slice helpers** <br> `pkg/workload/*`, `pkg/workloadslicing/*`, `pkg/util/testingjobs/*`|Elastic workload detection, topology-aware request building, Spark wrapper setters, and workload-slicing wiring are updated.|
|**Visibility and metrics tests** <br> `pkg/visibility/server.go`, `pkg/metrics/metrics_test.go`|Visibility server defaults and cluster-queue metric assertions are updated.|

**E2E and integration test updates**

|Layer / File(s)|Summary|
|---|---|
|**E2E common infrastructure** <br> `hack/testing/*`, `test/util/*`, `test/e2e/config/*`, `test/performance/*`|Retry helpers, webhook readiness checks, image caching, shard constants, and shared test manifests/utilities are added or updated.|
|**MultiKueue e2e suites** <br> `test/e2e/multikueue/*`|Baseline, extended, and sequential MultiKueue test suites and helper functions are reorganized for new shard and admission flows.|
|**Single-cluster and TAS e2e suites** <br> `test/e2e/sequential/*`, `test/e2e/tas/*`, `test/e2e/singlecluster/*`|Suite labels, readiness waits, Spark image selection, and Ray/KubeFlow assertions are updated.|
|**Utility tests and performance thresholds** <br> `test/util/*`, `test/performance/*`|Shared timeout-aware helpers and performance thresholds are adjusted.|
|**Integration tests** <br> `test/integration/singlecluster/*`|DRA, scheduler, and LocalQueue webhook integration tests are updated for the new validation and quota behaviors.|
